scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the square-power sum and integers with at least two distinct prime factors; it does not classify the higher-support solution set or assert novel numerical witnesses. Unindexed earlier equivalent statements remain possible.
title: Sharp prime-support thresholds for divisibility by the sum of prime squares
